messages:
maya_sales: Quick ask  BlackRiver wants a hosted POC key for a 48h demo. They require auditable rotation logs and a revoke-by-email fallback. Who can provision?

tony_se: I can. Recommend ttl=48h, scopes: generate,embeddings, and add IP allowlist if demo runs from a fixed office network. For demo mobile, use backend broker.

tony_se: Create example: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SA_TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"blackriver-demo","scopes":["generate:text","embeddings:read"],"ttl_hours":48,"ip_allowlist":["203.0.113.0/24"]}' | jq .

raj_infra: Note: when provisioning, we can enable audit-forwarding to the customer's Splunk/Datadog. Also default log retention is 90 days. For longer retention, request ticket.

maya_sales: They want proof of rotation in the compliance packet. Can we export the events after rotation?

sara_compliance: Yes. We provide an export API: GET /v1/audit/keys?key_id=kr_200255&since=2123456000&until=2123550000. The export includes create, rotate, revoke events with actor and ISO timestamps.

ticket-bot: [automated] key_request_created id=kr_200255 owner=maya_sales ttl=48h scope=generate:text,embeddings:read status=awaiting-infra

raj_infra: Approved. I'll provision and enable audit-forwarding. Will attach sample export to the sales ticket.

tony_se: Revocation CLI: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/kr_200255/revoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SA_TOKEN' . Console path: Console -> Keys -> kr_200255 -> Revoke.

maya_sales: Thanks. Please also add an email revoke flow (if compliance officer sends an email to security@redwood.ai we will validate and run the revoke).

sara_compliance: Added process: email must include ticket ID and SSO identity; security will verify and call revoke. This generates an audit event and signed export if requested.

maya_sales: Great. Leaving this open until the ticket has the export link.
